function.name: solve_ode_runge_kutta
function.description: Numerically solves a first-order ordinary differential equation dy/dx = f(x, y) over the interval [x0, x_end] using the classic 4th-order Runge–Kutta method.

x0.description: Initial value of the independent variable x.

y0.description: Initial value of the dependent variable y at x = x0.

x_end.description: Final value of x where the solution should stop.
